# The Verge
> The Verge is a technology publication covering how tech affects culture, society, entertainment, science, and everyday life.

Founded in 2011, The Verge publishes breaking news, product reviews, features, investigations, videos, and podcasts across consumer technology, major tech platforms, policy, business, AI, and science.

## Main Sections
- [Home](https://www.theverge.com/): Front page for The Verge’s latest news, reviews, features, and analysis.
- [Tech](https://www.theverge.com/tech): Core technology news covering devices, platforms, apps, and industry developments.
- [Reviews](https://www.theverge.com/reviews): Product reviews, testing, recommendations, and hands-on coverage across consumer electronics.
- [Science](https://www.theverge.com/science): Science reporting on space, climate, health, and emerging research.
- [Entertainment](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment): Coverage of streaming, gaming-adjacent media, creators, and digital entertainment.
- [AI](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence): Reporting on artificial intelligence products, companies, policy, and societal impact.
- [Policy](https://www.theverge.com/policy): News and analysis on regulation, antitrust, privacy, and platform governance.
- [Business](https://www.theverge.com/business): Tech business coverage focused on strategy, markets, labor, and competition.

## Reviews
- [Reviews](https://www.theverge.com/reviews): All product reviews, buying advice, and reviewer recommendations.
- [Smart Home Reviews](https://www.theverge.com/smart-home-review): Reviews of smart speakers, cameras, locks, lights, and connected home devices.
- [Phone Reviews](https://www.theverge.com/phone-review): Smartphone reviews covering flagship, foldable, and budget devices.
- [Tablet Reviews](https://www.theverge.com/tablet-review): Tablet reviews for iPad, Android, and productivity-focused devices.
- [Headphone Reviews](https://www.theverge.com/headphone-review): Reviews of headphones, earbuds, and audio accessories.
- [See All Reviews](https://www.theverge.com/reviews): Index of The Verge’s review coverage across product categories.

## AI and Emerging Technology
- [AI](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence): Central AI coverage including models, assistants, startups, and regulation.
- [Tech](https://www.theverge.com/tech): Broader reporting on emerging products, software, and platform shifts.
- [Google](https://www.theverge.com/google): Coverage of Gemini, Android, Search, Pixel, and Google’s AI strategy.
- [Microsoft](https://www.theverge.com/microsoft): News on Windows, Copilot, Xbox, cloud, and Microsoft’s AI products.
- [Facebook](https://www.theverge.com/facebook): Reporting on Meta, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and AI initiatives.
- [Business](https://www.theverge.com/business): Analysis of AI competition, investment, partnerships, and market impact.

## Science and Research
- [Science](https://www.theverge.com/science): Science desk coverage spanning space, climate, health, and research.
- [Tech](https://www.theverge.com/tech): Technology reporting that intersects with scientific advances and engineering.
- [AI](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence): AI developments with implications for research and society.
- [Policy](https://www.theverge.com/policy): Regulation and governance issues affecting scientific and technical fields.

## Policy and Regulation
- [Policy](https://www.theverge.com/policy): Core policy coverage on privacy, speech, antitrust, and regulation.
- [Business](https://www.theverge.com/business): Reporting on corporate power, labor, and industry competition.
- [AI](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence): AI policy, safety debates, and legislative developments.
- [Facebook](https://www.theverge.com/facebook): Platform moderation, social media governance, and Meta policy news.
- [Google](https://www.theverge.com/google): Search, advertising, Android, and antitrust-related Google coverage.
- [Apple](https://www.theverge.com/apple): App Store, device ecosystem, and regulatory reporting around Apple.

## Major Tech Companies
- [Apple](https://www.theverge.com/apple): News about iPhone, iPad, Mac, services, software, and Apple strategy.
- [Google](https://www.theverge.com/google): Coverage of Android, Pixel, Search, YouTube, and Google products.
- [Microsoft](https://www.theverge.com/microsoft): Reporting on Windows, Surface, Xbox, cloud, and enterprise moves.
- [Amazon](https://www.theverge.com/amazon): News on Amazon retail, devices, Prime, Alexa, and company strategy.
- [Facebook](https://www.theverge.com/facebook): Coverage of Meta platforms including Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.
- [Samsung](https://www.theverge.com/samsung): Reporting on Galaxy phones, foldables, TVs, appliances, and displays.

## Consumer Devices
- [Phone Reviews](https://www.theverge.com/phone-review): In-depth smartphone testing, comparisons, and recommendations.
- [Tablet Reviews](https://www.theverge.com/tablet-review): Reviews of tablets for entertainment, work, and creative use.
- [Headphone Reviews](https://www.theverge.com/headphone-review): Audio product reviews with focus on sound, comfort, and features.
- [Smart Home Reviews](https://www.theverge.com/smart-home-review): Reviews of connected home gadgets and home automation gear.
- [Apple](https://www.theverge.com/apple): Device news and ecosystem coverage for Apple hardware and software.
- [Samsung](https://www.theverge.com/samsung): Coverage of Samsung phones, tablets, wearables, and home electronics.

## Entertainment and Culture
- [Entertainment](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment): Coverage of streaming platforms, online media, and digital culture.
- [Tech](https://www.theverge.com/tech): Stories on how products and platforms shape media and culture.
- [Facebook](https://www.theverge.com/facebook): Social platform news affecting creators, communities, and online culture.
- [Google](https://www.theverge.com/google): YouTube, creator economy, and platform-related entertainment coverage.
- [Amazon](https://www.theverge.com/amazon): Prime Video, devices, and Amazon’s role in media and entertainment.

## Business and Industry
- [Business](https://www.theverge.com/business): Reporting on tech companies, markets, labor, and strategic shifts.
- [Amazon](https://www.theverge.com/amazon): Coverage of Amazon’s retail, logistics, devices, and corporate decisions.
- [Apple](https://www.theverge.com/apple): Business reporting on Apple’s products, services, and market positioning.
- [Google](https://www.theverge.com/google): News on Google’s advertising, cloud, hardware, and competitive strategy.
- [Microsoft](https://www.theverge.com/microsoft): Coverage of Microsoft’s enterprise, gaming, and cloud businesses.
- [Facebook](https://www.theverge.com/facebook): Reporting on Meta’s platforms, advertising business, and strategic direction.
